integrity: Universal theorem proved using explicit homotopy pushout and independence folds; finite verification is corroborative; independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact forest formula requires all deleted edges between the first two of at least three nonempty independent parts and an acyclic deleted-edge graph. General deletion patterns receive only a suspension reduction. Cyclic six-edge boundary differs. Integral persistence asserted for successive disjoint matching-edge deletions, not arbitrary edge orders.
title: Forest defects in multipartite clique-avoidance: a shape-invariant sphere-wedge law and an integral persistence transition
